title: The BSE Property for Weighted Banach Algebras of Dirichlet Series
summary: Let $ω: \mathbb{N} \to [1, \infty)$ be a weight on the multiplicative semigroup of natural numbers. We investigate the Bochner-Schoenberg-Eberlein (BSE) property for the weighted Banach algebra of Dirichlet series $A_ω= \ell^1(\mathbb{N}, ω)$ under Dirichlet convolution. By employing Bohr's correspondence, we establish a weak-$\ast$ approximation framework for $ω$-bounded semicharacters using scaled truncations that lie within the predual space $c_0(\mathbb{N}, 1/ω)$.
